fast: artifact=>provider.acquire/inspect/apply by verified ArtifactRoot ref; component=>provider.acquire/verify then component.release.apply; scheduled=>automation.register with per-run job grant; control JSON<=600B;2+=>job.batch;bulky=>artifact/plan/ref;large=>result.get;stage exact paths=>git.add.paths

common.artifact.chat.import.download: safe exact-basename .zip from user Downloads -> local_file provider; expected_sha256 required; cleanup_source?
common.artifact.cleanup: execute=false by default; true performs retention cleanup
common.browser.qa.status: no params; reports runner availability and live-capture boundary
common.browser.recipe.run: workspace,path(recipe JSON),baseline_id?,run_id?,job_id?; requires workspace browser tool permission
common.browser.live.capture.policy: no params; policy only, capture remains disabled until explicit consent-bound integration
common.artifact.provider.status: no params; provider runner + configured managed-folder ids + security boundary
common.artifact.provider.probe: provider,artifact_id?,source params; remote expected_sha256 required by acquire; no writes except audit
common.artifact.provider.acquire: provider,artifact_id?,expected_sha256(remote required),source params,signature?; writes only ArtifactRoot; never auto-executes
common.workspace.advanced.cleanup: removes expired/revoked/orphan grants and expired/orphan ephemeral workspaces
common.component.registry.status: no params; reports managed component/automation registries and security boundaries
common.component.dependency.acquire: id,provider,provider params; acquisition only through Artifact Provider; never auto-executes
common.component.remove: id; removes only managed component root; workspace/user data preserved
common.automation.register: id,workspace,path,type=interval|trigger,grant_scopes[],grant_tools[],interval_seconds>=60 or trigger_key,missed_run_policy,max_concurrency<=8,grant_ttl_seconds; grant template cannot exceed base workspace policy
common.automation.tick: no params; claims due interval runs with dedupe/bounded concurrency and job-scoped grants
common.automation.trigger: trigger_key,event_id; idempotent trigger claim using per-run grant/job
